description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pohoddaramulla, Kaluthara D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530014
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, ownership details, and encumbrances) in the Kalutara District. The content focuses entirely on land registration, ownership determinations, and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
